english.meaning: a glass container for keeping goldfish or other fish

exampleSentences.english: So you don’t get the worker to look after the fish? Your fish are quite pretty. Changing the water in such a big tank must be hard work.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉你唔叫工人睇住啲魚嚹喎。啊你啲魚都幾靚吖。咁大個金魚缸換水好辛苦𡃉喎。

exampleSentences.traditional: 我記得。你揾啲報紙包實晒個金魚缸吖嗎。
